The shortest tree is 6 feet tall.  
The second tree is 5 feet more than the shortest tree, so it is $6 + 5 = 11$ feet tall.  
The combined height of the shortest and second tree is $6 + 11 = 17$ feet.  
The tallest tree is twice the combined height of the other two trees, so it is $2 \times 17 = 34$ feet tall.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 34
